heading: Billing & Invoice Policy
intro: This Billing and Invoice Policy describes how Arseen Enterprises LLC invoices clients, collects payments, and handles billing disputes for all procurement, order fulfillment and related services provided by Arseen Enterprises LLC.

sections.title: Invoice Issuance
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC provides a written quotation based on the customer's product, quantity, destination, procurement, fulfillment, and applicable shipment requirements. After the customer approves the quotation, Arseen Enterprises LLC issues the applicable invoice or payment request. Unless different payment terms are expressly agreed in writing, payment is required before procurement or order fulfillment begins. Each invoice accurately identifies the applicable order, products and/or services, charges, amount due, and payment terms. Invoices are delivered electronically via email to the billing contact provided by the customer.

sections.title: Payment Confirmation
sections.body: Upon receipt of a completed payment, Arseen Enterprises LLC will send a written payment confirmation to the customer's email address on file. This confirmation serves as your receipt and includes the order reference number, amount paid, payment date, and a summary of the services or goods covered. If you do not receive a payment confirmation within 24 hours of completing your payment, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com.

sections.title: Payment Terms
sections.body: Unless different payment terms have been expressly agreed in writing, payment is required before procurement or order fulfillment begins. Payment terms are stated on the applicable quotation or invoice. Certain approved business customers may receive alternative payment terms when expressly agreed by Arseen Enterprises LLC in writing. Payments must be made in U.S. dollars via the payment methods accepted by Arseen Enterprises LLC unless a different currency is agreed upon in writing.

sections.title: Accepted Payment Methods
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC accepts payment via bank transfer (ACH/wire), electronic payment processors, and other authorized payment methods. Payment method details are provided on each invoice. Clients are responsible for any transaction fees charged by their payment provider. Payment card and electronic payment information is processed by authorized third-party payment processors and is not stored on Arseen Enterprises LLC's own servers.

sections.title: Late Payment
sections.body: Where payment terms have been agreed that allow deferred payment, invoices not paid within the agreed payment period may be subject to a late fee of 1.5% per month (18% per annum) on the outstanding balance. Arseen Enterprises LLC reserves the right to suspend services for accounts with overdue balances.

sections.title: Disputed Invoices
sections.body: Clients who dispute an invoice must notify Arseen Enterprises LLC in writing at support@arseenenterprises.com within 7 calendar days of the invoice date. Disputes submitted after this window may not be eligible for adjustment. We will investigate and respond within 5 business days. Submitting a billing dispute does not affect your right to file a dispute with your payment provider.

sections.title: Chargebacks and Payment Disputes
sections.body: Customers are encouraged to contact Arseen Enterprises LLC directly before initiating a payment dispute or chargeback so that the issue can be reviewed and, where possible, resolved promptly. Nothing in this policy limits any rights available to a customer under applicable law, card-network rules, or payment-provider dispute procedures. Arseen Enterprises LLC will respond to all payment disputes and chargebacks promptly and in good faith, and may provide accurate transaction, invoice, fulfillment, communication, tracking, and delivery records when responding to a payment dispute.

sections.title: Taxes and Duties
sections.body: All invoiced amounts are exclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Clients are responsible for any sales tax, VAT, customs duties, or other government-imposed charges applicable to their jurisdiction. Arseen Enterprises LLC will provide documentation to support tax compliance upon request.

sections.title: Currency
sections.body: All invoices are issued in United States Dollars (USD) unless a different currency is agreed upon in writing. Currency conversion fees, if any, are the responsibility of the client.

sections.title: Invoice Records
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC retains invoice and payment records for a minimum of 7 years in compliance with Wyoming business record-keeping requirements and applicable federal regulations. Clients may request copies of past invoices at any time by contacting support@arseenenterprises.com.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Billing refunds are governed by our Refund Policy. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of written approval.

sections.title: Contact for Billing Inquiries
sections.body: For all billing questions, invoice disputes, or payment arrangements, contact support@arseenenterprises.com. Response time: 1–2 business days. Arseen Enterprises LLC (US Office Address: 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States).
